The Pearl Protocol

Every case follows
the same discipline.

No guesswork, no surprises. From first scan to final polish, your treatment runs on a documented protocol — you see the plan, the timeline, and the fee before anything begins.

VISIT 01

Consultation & imaging

Full clinical exam, intraoral scan, and CBCT imaging where indicated. Your entire mouth, charted and recorded.

60 min · AED 350, credited to treatment

VISIT 02

Design & planning

Your clinician presents the plan: simulations, materials, alternatives, and a fixed written quotation.

45 min · No obligation

VISIT 03

Treatment

Performed under magnification with anaesthesia protocols tuned to you. Anxious patients are our specialty, not our problem.

Per plan · Sedation available

VISIT 04

Finish & review

Final fit, occlusion check, photography, and a recall schedule. Every aesthetic case carries a 5-year ceramic warranty.

30 min · Warranty issued
